marks.gloss_en: אלא: שייר ערב הפסח שחל להיות בערב שבת, אפיק שית ועייל שית (= p_shayar_erev_pesach_beerev_shabbat)
he omitted Pesach eve that falls on Shabbat eve -- take out six, put in six
אי משום ערב הפסח -- לאו שיורא הוא, דהא מני רבי יהודה היא, דאמר: מימיהם של כת שלישית לא הגיעה לומר אהבתי -- per R' Yehuda Pesach eve does not reach forty-eight
R' Yehuda: never did the third shift reach [the hallel passage] 'I love that the Lord hears', for its people were few
(הא אוקימנא) דלא כרבי יהודה! -- at 53b.10 we established the mishnah is not R' Yehuda's
ודלמא האי תנא סבר לה כוותיה בחדא, ופליג עליה בחדא -- this tanna may agree with him on one matter (the third shift) and dispute him on one (the tally)
דתניא, אחרים אומרים: only four [weekdays] between RH and RH -- the year is not adjusted, so Yom Kippur may follow Shabbat (marker is דתניא; see header)
between Atzeret and Atzeret, and between Rosh HaShana and Rosh HaShana, there are only four days [of the week], and in a leap year five
ולא? והא איכא ערב הפסח שחל להיות בשבת -- per R' Yehuda fifty-one blasts, per the Rabbis fifty-seven: more than forty-eight
כי קתני מידי דאיתיה בכל שנה -- the tanna counts only what occurs every year (= p_tani_midi_deitei)
אטו ערב שבת שבתוך החג מי איתיה בכל שנה? זימנין דלא משכחת ליה -- when the first festival day falls on Shabbat eve [there is no Shabbat eve within the Festival], yet the mishnah lists it
the tanna lists [only] what occurs every year; Erev Pesach on Shabbat, which does not occur every year, he does not list
כי מקלע יום טוב ראשון בערב שבת מדחי דחינן ליה -- the case never arises: it is postponed, lest Yom Kippur fall on Sunday (= p_dachinan_yom_tov_rishon, p_dachinan_taam)
when the first festival day would fall on Shabbat eve, we postpone it
ומי דחינן ליה? והא תנן: חלבי שבת קריבין ביום הכפורים -- Yom Kippur can follow Shabbat; and R' Zeira's report (54b.8) of the baraita on YK on Friday and on Sunday shows the same
the fats of Shabbat [offerings] are offered on Yom Kippur
לא קשיא: הא רבנן, הא אחרים (= p_mishnatenu_rabanan, p_chelvei_shabbat_acherim)
this [our mishnah, which presumes the postponement] is the Rabbis'
מיתיבי: the RC song pushes aside the Shabbat song; ואי איתא, לימא דשבת ולימא דראש חדש -- if one sounds for each musaf, both songs should be said
Rosh Chodesh that fell on Shabbat: the song of Rosh Chodesh pushes aside the song of Shabbat
מאי דוחה -- דוחה לקדם: both are said, the RC song first (= p_rav_safra_likadem)
ואמאי? תדיר ושאינו תדיר -- תדיר קודם: the Shabbat song is the more frequent and should come first
Rav Safra: what is 'pushes aside'? pushes aside to come first
לידע שהוקבע ראש חדש בזמנו (= p_yochanan_leida_shir)

והאי היכירא עבדינן? הא היכירא אחרינא עבדינן! -- the RC fats placed under the karkov, which R' Yochanan himself explains as making known that RC was fixed in its time (p_yochanan_leida_chelavim, 55a.1)
R' Yochanan: [the Rosh Chodesh song comes first] to make known that Rosh Chodesh was fixed in its time
Yom Kippur that fell on Shabbat eve -- they did not sound [the blasts]; at the close of Shabbat [i.e. YK on Sunday] they did not recite havdala
